types.name: Synonym of a given word
types.description: A single word stands alone after the instruction (often in capitals or bold), e.g. 'Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word. CANDID', and the four options are single words.

types.name: Synonym of a word in a sentence
types.description: A full sentence is given with one word underlined, bold or italicised, and the question asks for its synonym or for the word that can replace it in that sentence.

types.name: Fill the blank with a synonym
types.description: A sentence has a blank followed by a word in brackets, e.g. 'The doctor has ______ (advised) medicine', and the question asks for the synonym of the bracketed word that fits the blank.

types.name: Meaning of a word
types.description: The question asks for the meaning of a given or underlined word (not 'synonym'), and the options are short phrases or definitions rather than single words.
